title: Machine-readable risk register linked to controls and evidence
objective: Hold each risk as a record with owner, ratings, treatment, linked controls and evidence; validate that high risks have at least one linked operating control and that treatment dates are not overdue.
owner: Managing member of Echelon Foundry, LLC (role not yet formally assigned)

title: Exception records with CI-enforced expiry
objective: Make build and release gates honor only unexpired, approved exception records and fail on unmatched suppressions or expired exceptions.
owner: Managing member of Echelon Foundry, LLC (role not yet formally assigned)
residual_risks: Repository administrators can alter gate configuration; detection relies on audit logs.

title: Independent review of risk acceptances
objective: Have an advisor independent of ownership review every risk acceptance above a defined rating within 30 days.
owner: Managing member of Echelon Foundry, LLC (role not yet formally assigned)

title: Derived critical vendor inventory with assessment tracking
objective: Derive the vendor and subprocessor inventory from infrastructure definitions, SBOM and billing records and track assessment, contract and exit plan status per vendor.
owner: Managing member of Echelon Foundry, LLC (role not yet formally assigned)

title: Assurance claim reconciliation check
objective: Block publication of customer-facing statements (trust center, questionnaire answers, marketing) that claim a status higher than the answer unit or control register supports.
owner: Managing member of Echelon Foundry, LLC (role not yet formally assigned)
notes: The operating contract says the build tool enforces statement kind versus status; tools/build.fsx was not found in this repository at authoring time.
